title: chat-vtc-server eject_banned_user panics on an unchecked Id
description: Found in ibyi group C: jmap_chat_vtc_server::eject_banned_user calls serde_json::from_value(..).expect(..) on each 'left' event; panics if account_id or a stored call/participant id is an invalid Id built with Id::from. It already returns Result: return an error instead, add a test, drop the # Panics note. Same pattern as JMAP-x3s1.
